prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Check for object. Approach it if visible, scan area if not visible. Grab and process object, then move to destination. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ProcessObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
		DO MoveToDestination
	END
